hook_line: DIWALI AND CHHATH FARES ARE UP

hook_stat.sub: Of travellers flying home for the festivals are paying more than in 2025

news_summary: A LocalCircles survey found 72% of travellers flying home for Diwali and Chhath are paying more for flights than in 2025.
payoff: Fares are expected to ease after November 20.
